component.name: Organiza
component.summary: Focus sessions, habits and app blocking that stay on your computer

description.p: Organiza pauses distracting apps during focus sessions and once their daily limit is used, and asks you to choose on purpose before going back. It tracks screen time, habits and your schedule.
Everything stays in an encrypted database on this computer. There is no telemetry, and blocking and scheduling work offline. AI coaching is optional and uses your own Groq key.
